finding: The 145 spinflip_local_covariance sentence gives the determinant phase with the wrong exponent. The exact identity for every U in U(2), with bar denoting entrywise conjugation, is Y conjugate(U)=det(U)^(-1) U Y, not det(U) U Y.
exact_written_diagnostic: For U=e^(i theta) I_2, Y conjugate(U)=e^(-i theta)Y. The correct right side det(U)^(-1) UY is e^(-i theta)Y; the erroneous det(U) UY would be e^(3 i theta)Y and fails for general theta.
effect: The intended density/projector local covariance is unchanged because the determinant prefactor is a scalar of unit modulus and cancels under outer products.
